name: FlashArray - protect now (day 2)
description: An operator asks for an array to be protected now: an immediate snapshot of every local protection group and, when asked, a longer eradication delay. A human approves it, the protect-now playbook runs through the FlashArray collection and the outcome is logged with the AAP job link. A rejection is logged and changes nothing.

extend_eradication_by_s.title: Extend the eradication delay by (seconds)
extend_eradication_by_s.description: Seconds added to the array's enabled eradication delay, rounded up to whole days and capped at the module's 30 days; 0 snapshots only and leaves the delay alone. The delay is never shortened.

parameters.prompt: Snapshot every local protection group on ${trigger.array} now and lengthen its enabled eradication delay by ${trigger.extend_eradication_by_s} seconds (rounded up to whole days, at most 30, never shortened). The snapshots count against the array's capacity until they expire or are destroyed.

extra_vars.subject: Protect now on ${trigger.array}: snapshots ${protect_now.artifacts.snapshot_suffix}
extra_vars.detail: Snapshotted: ${protect_now.artifacts.groups_snapshotted}; failed: ${protect_now.artifacts.groups_failed}; enabled eradication delay: ${protect_now.artifacts.eradication_delay_days} days. AAP job: ${protect_now.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: Protect now on ${trigger.array} rejected or expired; nothing changed
extra_vars.detail: The approval was rejected or timed out after 24 hours. Raise a new request if the protection is still wanted.
